description: Figure 6 (left), titled “Distribution of data source in the AttrEval-Simulation,” is a pie chart showing how the combined training and AttrEval-Simulation sets are divided across data sources, with 6 slices in total; the slices are labeled with percentages placed next to the chart (rather than inside the wedges): ENTITYQUEST is shown in blue at about 26.0%, HOTPOTQA is shown in red at about 24.2%, TRIVIAQA is shown in orange at about 22.7%, POPQA is shown in yellow at about 21.6%, WEBQUESTIO is a small light-cyan slice at about 3.6%, and TREC is a very small green slice at about 1.9%. There is no separate legend box visible, and none of the slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized.
